syllabus: Unit 2 teaches ここ／そこ／あそこ／どこ, こちら／そちら／あちら／どちら, あります, います, 〜に〜があります, 〜は〜にあります, 〜の上／中／前, 〜や〜など, いくつ／いくら and 〜ぐらい／〜ごろ: is this a fair N5 set in a sensible order, given that some items already use verbs (行きませんか, 出ます), 〜たい and 〜てください, which come in units 3, 4 and 6?

n5u02d1.c1: Answer こちら (先生、こちらは友だちのリンさんです). If the speaker were pointing at a photo, これ would fit. Is こちら clearly the only answer here?
n5u02d1.d2: Rewritten after the check (A「すみません、学校は（　　）ですか。」, answer どこ). Please read once.
n5u02d1.k: Words used on this day: しょくどう, うけつけ (N4?), エレベーター and the name 山川大学. Fine for N5?
n5u02d1.r1: Answer うけつけ, resting on そのまえに; the script uses 〜てください (unit 6). The man is already beside reception: is はじめに　どこへ　行きますか natural, and the answer clear?
n5u02d2.p1: The watch note: ここにペンじゃありません (wrong) → ここにペンはありません. A mistake learners really make, and clearly explained?
n5u02d2.c1: Day 2 already uses に with places (こうえんに, 川に), taught on day 3. Fine to use it this early?
n5u02d2.d5: Star item (その店に日本語の本がありますか). ★ on あります. Too easy?
n5u02d2.d6: Star item, ★ on が; may be easy. Is the next sentence 名前はケンくんです natural?
n5u02d2.e2: Answer います (きょうしつに　だれか　いますか). だれか is not taught yet. Fair here?
n5u02d2.e3: Star item (あの　川には　小さい　魚が　いますよ). ★ on 魚. Too easy?
n5u02d2.r1: The passage uses あまり〜ません, 〜が for 'but' (unit 7) and 行きませんか (unit 3). Fair for day 2, and is 白い　ねこが　います the only true choice?
n5u02d3.p2: The watch note: 母は店でいます (wrong) → 母は店にいます. A good example of で misused for where someone is?
n5u02d3.c1: The third compare form is 本やは二かいです. Helpful beside 〜は〜にあります? Place-first sentences use に without は (二かいに何が…). Fine?
n5u02d3.k1: Made-up wrong readings in kanji items: にゅうぐち, いれくち here; にしくち, せいぐち for 西口 (day 6). Clearly wrong to a native, and acceptable as distractors?
n5u02d3.e3: Star item (うちの　ちかくに　大きい　店が　あります). Is 大きい店 natural here (not 大きな店), and is the item too easy?
n5u02d4.p2: The watch note: つくえの上に本やがあります (wrong) → 本などがあります. Clear, given that 本や also means a bookshop?
n5u02d4.c1: Answer と (ペンとけしゴムです。それだけです). Is や clearly wrong because of それだけです?
n5u02d4.d2: Answer 左 (I am on Yamakawa's right, so he is on my left). More logic than grammar: fair as a drill item?
n5u02d4.k: Classroom picture: all eight words are position words (上, 下, 中, 外, 前, 後ろ, 右, 左). Fine as a scene?
n5u02d4.r1: Rewritten after the check (はこの　中には　ペンや　ノートなどが　あります). Please read once. 本だな is in the passage: fine for N5?
n5u02d5.p1: The watch note: このかばんはいくつですか (wrong, for a price) → いくらですか. Clearly wrong to a native?
n5u02d5.p2: The watch note: 二時間ごろべんきょうしました (wrong) → 二時間ぐらい. A clear example of ごろ misused?
n5u02d5.c1: The third compare form is 何時ごろ, beside いくつ and いくら. Useful in this comparison?
n5u02d5.d4: Answer ごろ (まいあさ七時ごろおきます). Please confirm など is clearly wrong.
n5u02d5.e1: Answer いくら (この　ノートは　いくらですか). Very close to drill d1. Too similar?
n5u02d5.k: Café scene: 魚 stands alone as a menu word. Natural on a café menu?
n5u02d5.r1: Quick response, answer 百二十円です. Close in pattern to drill d1. Too similar, and are はい、一つです and 三つあります clearly wrong?
n5u02d6.c1: A compare example uses 九時ごろホテルを出ます; verbs come in unit 3. Fine here?
n5u02d6.d2: Answer いくつ (このホテルには、へやがいくつありますか… 百ぐらい). Is には natural here, and いくつ fine for about 100 rooms?
n5u02d6.d3: Answer あそこ (あそこにいますよ). Option あの has no noun after it. Clearly wrong to a learner?
n5u02d6.d5: Rewritten after the check (あの車の中にいますよ). Please read once.
n5u02d6.e1: Answer が (ロビーに　だれが　いますか). The explanation says a question word does not take は. Accurate enough for N5?
n5u02d6.k: Words on this day that may be above N5: あんないばん (scene title), きっさてん, カメラ, ロビー, どのぐらい. Fine?
n5u02d6.r1: Answer 二かい. The question uses 買いたいです (〜たい comes in unit 4). Fair here?
n5u02t.5: Answer かい. The blank splits 三かい (三（　　）に). Clear as a counter question?
n5u02t.7: Answer ゆうびんきょくは　ぎんこうの　左. Right and left assume both buildings are seen from the front. Clear enough?
n5u02t.8: Words in this test that may be above N5: げんかん (here), たてもの (t.9), さいふ (t.17), サンドイッチ, メロンパン (t.21–22). Fine?
n5u02t.16: Star item, ★ on 白い. Too easy?
n5u02t.18: Star item (午後　五時ごろから　いますよ). から for time comes in unit 5. Fair here?
n5u02t.23: The passage uses 見ませんか (unit 3) and えいがかん (N5?). Fair here?
sound.u2d6.電話: Synthetic voice: speech recognisers hear this word as では or でも (as in unit 1). Please listen (N5 unit 2, day 6, the floor guide, tap 電話).
sound.u2d4.下: Synthetic voice: both recognisers heard 下 (した) as something else. Please listen (N5 unit 2, day 4, the room picture, tap 下).
